messages:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the recent outage re: rollout safety. Need a compact set of follow-ups: who owns remediation, concrete timelines, and a recurring check to catch repeats.

ben: Agreed. We keep seeing the same pattern: noisy model variant -> slow degradation -> manual rollback. Can we standardize a 3-step response? quarantine -> degrade -> rollback.

olivia: For that we need clear signatures and the telemetry to compute them. Propose: error_rate_delta (5m), p95_latency_delta (5m), and a lightweight fidelity check against 200 prober prompts.

ravi: +1 on the prober set. Also: we should track incident repeat fingerprints (flag id + model id + signature) so we can surface patterns in the 30/90 day reviews.

sasha: Drafted a compact flag gating JSON so infra can consume it. Example: 

```
{
  "flag_id": "ml-feature-A",
  "phases": ["0.5%","5%","20%","100%"],
  "phase_timeout_mins": 45,
  "containment_window_mins": 15,
  "auto_actions": [
    {"name":"quarantine","if":{"error_rate_multiplier":4, "p95_multiplier":2}},
    {"name":"degrade","action":"pin_previous_variant","hold_minutes":10},
    {"name":"rollback","if":{"quality_drop_pct":3}}
  ]
}
```

ben: That JSON looks usable. A few notes: make phase list configurable per-route, and default timeouts only applied when not explicitly set.

olivia: For telemetry: add counters `quarantine.triggered`, `degrade.executed`, `rollback.executed`, and gauge `time_in_quarantine`. We'll also emit an event with `fingerprint` so analytics can group repeats.

ravi: Ownership proposal:
 - sasha: own the gating spec RFC and example configs (due in 4 business days)
 - ben: runtime hooks for containment timer + degrade action (due in 2 weeks)
 - olivia: prober set + fidelity eval pipeline + baseline snapshots (due in 7 days)
 - ravi: analytics dashboard and 30/90 day recurrence report (due in 3 weeks)

ops-bot: REMINDER: any PR that changes rollout defaults must include a `smoke-rollout` job and pass `./ci/smoke_rollout_test.sh`.

ben: We should also add a soft-fallback option that reduces sample-rate to 5% instead of full rollback for experimental features. That gives us human time to triage.

olivia: And include a required `audit.deploy_config_id` field so postmortems can point to the exact gating config used during an incident.

ravi: One more: schedule a recurring 30-day "recurrence review" meeting auto-invited to owners where the recurrence dashboard shows any fingerprints with >1 occurrence in last 90 days. Rotate ownership weekly.

sasha: I'll open the RFC and attach example configs + the action items. Filing tasks now. If nobody objects I'll tag owners and set due dates per above.

ben: No objections. :+1:

olivia: ACK, will start the prober + baseline snapshots tomorrow.

ravi: ACK, will prototype the recurrence fingerprint in analytics this week.

sasha: thanks everyone. I'll post links when RFC + PRs are up.
